cells.gaps: Nothing found since October 2023 says whether control of state data is a stated goal or a rule; Decree 2020-146 (DJI-001) is older than the three-year window.
cells.note: Customs data have been held in the customs directorate's own data centre in Djibouti since 2010, ADI reported in December 2024 (DJI-002), but every lower rung needs its own evidence and no strategy or rule inside the window is held, so no rung is set.
